app_user.username: the board user (NO_LOGIN_USER); an identity, not board content
app_user.key_id: fingerprint of the data key, not the key
app_user.key_slots: data key wrapped under an Argon2-derived key; offline passphrase guessing at worst, no content
task.status: workflow state from a fixed list
task.priority: workflow setting from a fixed list
task.model: Claude model name chosen from a list
task.session_id: Claude Code session id; a pointer, not the transcript
task.pr_state: PR state word (open, merged); not which PR
task.requested_lane: lane the user asked for; routing
task.created_by: who made the card, from a fixed list (user, agent, schedule)
task.moved_by: who made the last status change, from a fixed list
task.fork_of: opaque id of the task this one was forked from
task.watch_stops: ids of watches to stop; ids only, the watches themselves are sealed
schedule.priority: workflow setting from a fixed list
schedule.model: Claude model name chosen from a list
note.author: who wrote it, from a fixed list
note.kind: note type, from a fixed list
note.by: who acted, from a fixed list
task_pr.state: PR state word; not which PR (the PR reference is sealed)
machine.name: worker machine name; infrastructure
machine.token_hash: hash of the machine token, not the token
transcript_run.session_id: Claude Code session id; a pointer, not the transcript
transcript_event.kind: event type, from a fixed list
transcript_event.parent: sequence number of the parent event
transcript_event.output_size: byte count of the sealed output
task.effort: effort level from a fixed list
schedule.effort: effort level from a fixed list
machine.feed_requests: pending actions on feeds, <action>:<feed id>: action words from a fixed list and opaque ids, no content
app_user.source: sign-in method word from a fixed list; always null on a no-login board
session.token_hash: login sessions: a token hash (not the token), identity, a method word, timestamps; empty on a no-login board
session.owner: login sessions: a token hash (not the token), identity, a method word, timestamps; empty on a no-login board
session.method: login sessions: a token hash (not the token), identity, a method word, timestamps; empty on a no-login board
session.created_at: login sessions: a token hash (not the token), identity, a method word, timestamps; empty on a no-login board
session.last_seen_at: login sessions: a token hash (not the token), identity, a method word, timestamps; empty on a no-login board
session.expires_at: login sessions: a token hash (not the token), identity, a method word, timestamps; empty on a no-login board
passkey.credential_id: WebAuthn credentials: public material, a device label the user chose (plain by the core's design, like a machine name), counters, timestamps; empty on a no-login board
passkey.owner: WebAuthn credentials: public material, a device label the user chose (plain by the core's design, like a machine name), counters, timestamps; empty on a no-login board

passkey.transports: WebAuthn credentials: public material, a device label the user chose (plain by the core's design, like a machine name), counters, timestamps; empty on a no-login board
passkey.name: WebAuthn credentials: public material, a device label the user chose (plain by the core's design, like a machine name), counters, timestamps; empty on a no-login board
